explanation: `Matrix.UnitriangularGroup` is the library's own definition. A case-insensitive search for "unitriangular" across all of Mathlib returns nothing. I also searched Mathlib for nilpotency results about matrix groups (`nilpotencyClass` near `Matrix`, `upperTriangular`, `BlockTriangular`). I found only results about determinants and characteristic polynomials of triangular matrices, and nothing on the nilpotency class of a unitriangular group. The proof uses general Mathlib facts: `Subgroup.lowerCentralSeries_eq_bot_iff_nilpotencyClass_le`, and `Subgroup.descending_central_series_ge_lower`, which says the lower central series lies below any descending central series. The real content is the library's own work: it builds a descending central series and shows it reaches ⊥ at step n−1. So no Mathlib declaration carries this result.
